description: Maya owns a duplicate 1970s concert poster and must decide whether to trade it in an informal swap for a custom record shelf, while comparing another offer and verifying the shelf's practical specifications.

shared_context.S1: Maya has one duplicate 1970s concert poster that she is willing to trade rather than sell for cash.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final decision about whether to trade the poster and what verbal terms to accept.
shared_context.S3: Eli has offered to arrange a record-storage solution in exchange for the poster.
shared_context.S4: Before agreeing, Maya follows her usual swap routine: each person states any terms, competing offer, or practical condition relevant to the exchange.

PF1.text: Eli's exact proposal is to trade the poster for one custom solid-pine record shelf, delivered assembled to Maya, plus installation of the wall anchors, on June 8.

PF2.text: June is prepared to trade two rare jazz LPs for the poster, with pickup at her apartment on June 5; she has not made that offer to Maya yet.

PF3.text: Ravi inspected Eli's shelf at the workshop and confirmed that it is solid pine, 90 centimeters wide, and rated to hold 40 kilograms; those specifications have not yet been stated to Maya.

acceptance_conditions: The poster must be traded to Eli.
The exchange must include one assembled record shelf and wall-anchor installation.
The shelf must be confirmed as solid pine, 90 centimeters wide, and rated for 40 kilograms.
Delivery must be committed for June 8.
June's competing offer must be recorded exactly as two rare jazz LPs with June 5 pickup.
Ravi's shelf inspection must be cited as justification for accepting the shelf specifications.

content_checks.C3: decisions['shelf_material'] == 'solid pine' and decisions['shelf_width_cm'] == 90 and decisions['shelf_load_kg'] == 40
content_checks.C6: decisions['alternative_offer_recorded'] == 'A3: two rare jazz LPs, pickup June 5'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'shelf_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Eli' and c['detail'] == 'assembled shelf delivered June 8' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'wall_anchor_installation' and c['target'] == 'Maya' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Eli's exact proposal changes the settlement from an unspecified possible swap to Eli as partner, a poster-for-shelf exchange, June 8 delivery, and included wall-anchor installation.
June's offer changes the comparison field from no concrete alternative to exactly two rare jazz LPs available for June 5 pickup.
Ravi's inspection changes the shelf description to solid pine, exactly 90 centimeters wide, and exactly rated for 40 kilograms, and supplies the inspection fact that Maya must cite.
